Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 05 October 2026 5 October 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transaction in Own Shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 28 September 2026 to 2 October 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from Barclays Bank plc ("Barclays") as part of its £386 million share repurchase programme announced on 15 July 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from Barclays as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE"). Following the above purchases and cancellation of the ordinary shares, the Company holds no ordinary shares in treasury and has 1,383,490,087 ordinary shares in issue. The total number of voting rights in the Company is therefore 1,383,490,087.
